main.description: Returns globally accurate aggregate counts for a DID: follower count, share count. Computed from all PDS repos the relay tracks.

did.description: The DID to query counts for.

followerCount.description: Total number of follow records targeting this DID across all tracked repos.

shareCount.description: Total number of article share records authored by this DID across all tracked repos.

feedSubscriptionCount.description: Total number of feed subscription records authored by this DID.
